note: The description comes from the Diagnostic characters of the entry 22. Eremotermes sanyuktae Thakur in the same fauna (State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat), covering the soldier and the two worker forms; the original has no measurement table, and all values are taken from the body of that paragraph.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark straw-coloured. Body length including the mandibles 3.00—3.05 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular; head length including the mandibles 1.85—1.93 mm, without the mandibles 1.00—1.03 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, the 1st segment rather long, the 3rd shortest, the terminal segment clavate. Labrum ligulate, 0.13—0.15 mm long and 0.18—0.20 mm wide, anterior margin pointed, with several long and short hairs. Mandibles stout, tapering forwards, strongly incurved at the tip; outer margin concave above the level of the teeth; teeth projecting and straight. Pronotum saddle-shaped; posterior margin nearly straight, with a median notch. Legs hairy, tarsi 4-segmented; tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow, body yellowish white and hairy. Body length 3.50—3.64 mm. Antennae 14-segmented. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length about half the width, anterior margin concave with a weak notch. Legs short and slender, tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Minor worker: like the major worker except slightly smaller.
